investigation_scope: Layer 2 (Task Orchestration & Remote Deployment) and Layer 3 (Research Coordination & Evidence Arbitration)

findings.name: Payload 完整性 - 能否将所有训练代码、资产、配置打包并哈希验证

features: PayloadManifest: immutable manifest with product_id, version, contract/runtime/source digests
build_payload_manifest: deterministic manifest from staged files with SHA256
verify_payload_archive: validates tar archive before upload (symlink/traversal rejection)
Embedded manifest in archive with checksum verification
integrity_guarantees: Content-addressed by payload_digest (SHA256 of unsigned manifest)
Archive verified locally before remote transport
Rejects absolute paths, .., symlinks, unsafe members

findings.name: 远程部署原子性 - 能否原子性地激活新 payload，失败时不污染环境

features: stage_runtime: runtime descriptor uploaded with SHA256 check
stage_payload: archive extracted to staging dir, then atomic mv -T to final
activate_run: run manifest atomically linked via active.json pointer
_atomic_active_pointer: atomic file replace with previous pointer backup
rollback_active: revert to a known-good immutable run
atomicity_guarantees: Staging in .staging-* temp dirs, then atomic rename to immutable identity
Concurrent deploy races handled: reuse if SHA256 matches
Failed deploy leaves staging dir, never touches immutable final
Active pointer updated atomically via temp file + mv -f

risks: Relies on POSIX mv -T atomicity; no distributed lock across multiple deployers
Staging cleanup is best-effort; orphaned .staging-* dirs accumulate on failures

findings.name: 进程生命周期管理 - 能否启动/暂停/恢复/终止远程训练进程

features_implemented: VersionedRemoteTrainingStarter: validated plan launch in tmux
tmux session lifecycle: create, send command, verify process by pgrep
RemoteSSH.tmux_reset: kill + create + pipe_pane (single-call pattern)
RemoteSSH.tmux_send: inject command as if typed
RemoteSSH.kill_train_procs: SIGKILL by process pattern
Process pattern validation and 5-attempt pgrep probe after launch
features_missing: 暂停 (pause): 无 SIGSTOP/SIGCONT 实现
恢复 (resume from pause): 无暂停态管理
优雅终止 (graceful shutdown): 仅有 SIGKILL，无 SIGTERM + wait + fallback SIGKILL

risks: SIGKILL 不给进程保存检查点机会，可能丢失最后一次保存后的训练进度
No pause/resume: 临时暂停需要 kill 整个进程，无法暂停 GPU 计算但保留内存
tmux pipe-pane 的 -o 标志是 toggle，第二次调用会关闭管道而不是切换路径
No background job management framework: 进程终止通知依赖轮询

findings.name: 日志与遥测采集 - 能否实时拉取训练日志、tensorboard 指标

features_implemented: parse_telemetry_jsonl: 解析 train.telemetry.jsonl 的实时遥测流
parse_training_log: fallback 解析 [TPREW]/[TPSTAT]/[TPCMD] 语义日志
RemoteSSH.exec_out: 远程命令执行获取日志尾部
RemoteSSH.get: SFTP 下载远程文件
build_run_snapshot: 从遥测构建指标快照、约束、阻塞项
Telemetry provenance tracking: 追踪 JSONL/log/console/tensorboard/checkpoint 路径
_gate_thresholds_from_config: 从 effective_config.yaml 读取阈值
features_missing: 实时 TensorBoard 指标拉取：有路径追踪，无 tfevents 解析器
流式采集：当前是轮询 + tail，无 inotify/WebSocket 推送
结构化日志采集 API：散布在 datasource/telemetry，无统一采集入口

risks: Telemetry 依赖 payload 写入 JSONL；旧 payload 只有日志 fallback，指标不完整
无 tensorboard 实时曲线：acceptance 依赖最终结果，中途曲线分析需手动
轮询延迟：无推送通知，发现问题可能滞后数个采样周期
SFTP get 无断点续传，大日志文件拉取失败需要重来

findings.name: SSH 连接鲁棒性 - 网络抖动时能否自动重连、不丢失状态

features_implemented: RemoteSSH: persistent paramiko client with reconnect
_ensure_connected: auto-reconnect on EOF/SSHException
exec with exponential backoff: min(2**attempt, 30) seconds, 5 retries default
put/get with backoff: 3 retries default
Host key verification: trust-on-first-use (TOFU) + persist to detect later MITM
reconnect_guarantees: Exponential backoff prevents SSH server overload
Each exec/put/get call is idempotent at retry boundary

risks: 无连接池：每个 RemoteSSH 实例是单连接，并发操作串行化
无状态恢复：重连后 tmux 会话仍在，但 RemoteSSH._pipe_set 标志丢失（内存态）
SSH keep-alive 未配置：长时间空闲可能被防火墙断开
Retry 只在单次调用内生效：上层轮询循环遇到断线会立即失败，无跨调用重连
No circuit breaker: 持续失败时无熔断，继续重试浪费资源

findings.name: 候选生成 - 能否根据当前瓶颈自动提出奖励/课程调整候选

features: MechanismSynthesizer.synthesize: 根据 SynthesisRequest (gaps, baseline) 生成候选
ResearchCycleManager.propose: 合成、验证、选择最优候选
Gap-driven synthesis: signal.name, bad/good bounds, desired direction, evidence_refs
Fingerprint deduplication: no_repeat_fingerprints prevents repeated rejected candidates
Validation before artifact compilation: 只有 validation.ok 的候选才编译 artifact
selection_criteria: Occam's razor: 更少操作、更少 guard 的有效候选优先

risks: Synthesis logic 不在此次调研文件中，无法确认生成算法完整性
Gap → Candidate 映射依赖 LLM/规则生成器，black box

findings.name: 实验编排 - 能否并行运行多个候选、管理资源、避免冲突

features_implemented: ResourceLeaseStore: filesystem-based lease for GPU/Isaac experiments
Lease acquisition with conflict check: requested resources vs active leases
Lease TTL (default 3600s) with auto-expiry
ResearchSupervisor.execute: single experiment execution with workspace isolation
ExperimentBackend protocol: start, poll, stop, evaluate
CommandExperimentBackend: subprocess-based local/remote command wrapper
features_missing: 并行编排：无 parallel experiment scheduler，只有单实验 execute
资源池管理：lease 只是互斥锁，无 GPU pool / priority queue
实验队列：无 pending queue，无优先级，无 backfill
分布式 lease：filesystem lock 无法跨机器，多训练机需外部协调

risks: 单机串行：当前 ResearchSupervisor 一次只运行一个实验，多候选需人工循环
Lease store 是本地文件锁：多客户端竞争时有 race condition (120s stale timeout)
No preemption: 低优先级实验无法被高优先级抢占
No resource quota: 无法限制单实验/用户的 GPU 时长

findings.name: 证据收集 - 训练指标、物理验收、对比基线的证据是否完整

evidence_types: Training telemetry: RunSnapshot with metrics, blockers, provenance
Physical acceptance: run_acceptance on remote, aggregate per-terrain scorecards
Baseline comparison: ResearchLedgerStore tracks BaselineSet, ContractBundle
Diagnostic reports: physeval_blind/physeval_blind_e with per-gate verdicts
Evidence routing: EvidenceSource registry (12+ source types)
acceptance_pipeline: acceptance_run.py: SSH + physeval_blind runner per terrain
Per-gate detail: A1..F2 with ok/detail, fall_rate secondary sort
BEST_CHECKPOINT.json: auto-update registry for highest-scoring checkpoint
evidence_provenance: evidence_refs in gaps/decisions: links to source artifacts

risks: Acceptance 依赖远程 physeval 运行：如果训练进程占用 GPU 会 OOM，需 --force 或手动暂停
Baseline comparison 在 ledger 中是结构化记录，但 diff/comparison tool 不在调研文件中
Evidence router 是静态映射，无动态证据收集策略（如 A/B test 自动设计）

findings.name: 决策自动化 - 能否根据证据自动选择最佳候选、拒绝劣化候选

features_implemented: ResearchCycleManager.propose: auto-select best valid candidate by selection_score
DecisionRecord: logs trigger, evidence_refs, selected/rejected options with reasons
OutcomeLearner.learn: extract outcome from execution and update research state
Rejection reasons: validation_failed, higher_occam_score
State update: pending_interventions, no_repeat_fingerprints, case status
decision_criteria: Lowest selection_score among valid candidates (Occam's razor)
features_missing: 自动拒绝劣化：无 baseline vs candidate 自动 stat test
Promotion 策略：disposition 是实验结果，但 auto-promote 逻辑不在调研文件中
多候选并行对比：串行实验，无 multi-armed bandit / A/B framework

risks: 决策主要基于 validation 和 Occam score，execution outcome (promote/rollback) 未自动连接到下一轮
无统计显著性检验：如果两个候选差异小，选择可能不稳定
No confidence interval: 单次实验结果无置信度，无法判断是否需要重复

summary.layer_2_status: 部分实现，核心基础设施完备，进程管理和采集有缺陷
summary.layer_3_status: 部分实现，单实验流程完整，并行编排和自动决策缺失

critical_gaps.impact: 多候选串行执行，研究周期长，GPU 利用率低

critical_gaps.gap: 进程优雅终止与暂停/恢复 (问题21)
critical_gaps.impact: SIGKILL 可能丢失检查点，无法临时暂停释放资源
中途曲线分析需手动，无法自动检测训练异常

critical_gaps.gap: 跨调用 SSH 重连与熔断 (问题23)
critical_gaps.impact: 长时间监控任务遇到网络抖动会失败，无自动恢复

critical_gaps.gap: 自动劣化拒绝与 stat test (问题18)
critical_gaps.impact: 候选优劣判断依赖人工或单次实验，可能选择假阳性

高: 问题16: 实验并行编排
中: 问题21: 进程生命周期
问题22: 日志遥测采集

recommendations.action: 实现 ResearchScheduler: 多候选并行队列、GPU pool、优先级调度
recommendations.rationale: 当前串行实验是研究循环的最大瓶颈，阻塞自动调参能力

recommendations.action: 添加 graceful_stop(SIGTERM + timeout + SIGKILL) 和 pause/resume(SIGSTOP/SIGCONT)
recommendations.rationale: 避免 SIGKILL 丢失检查点，支持资源抢占

recommendations.action: 实现跨调用重连管理器 + circuit breaker + SSH keep-alive 配置
recommendations.rationale: 提高长期监控任务稳定性，减少人工干预

recommendations.action: 添加 tensorboard tfevents 解析器，支持实时曲线采集
recommendations.rationale: 中途异常检测（如 reward collapse）依赖曲线，不能只看最终指标

recommendations.action: 实现 baseline vs candidate 统计检验（t-test/bootstrap CI）+ auto-promote 策略
recommendations.rationale: 避免噪声导致的假阳性选择，提高决策置信度
